sources.snippet: M6 — Contrastive Counterfactual Velocity (RoboWarp) π₀.₅ base finetuned on LIBERO-Spatial with a contrastive counterfactual objective: the CFM regression target stays plain (no steering), and an InfoNCE term makes the student's predicted velocity rank its own target above the evidence-blind counterfactual velocity.
